summary: Iter 253 — Banreservas ACH dual-format (TXT + XLSX) tested end-to-end. Backend: 6/6 pytest tests passed. Frontend: ACH dialog format toggle works perfectly (shown only for Banreservas, hidden for BHD/Popular). Both TXT (.txt, no query param) and XLSX (.xlsx, ?format=xlsx) downloads triggered and intercepted at the correct URLs.
critical_code_review_comments: bank_files.py:226+ — XLSX branch returns inside the if and bypasses the trailing `if not content.strip(): raise 400` guard. The XLSX branch now has its own equivalent guard (line 295) which is correct, but consider extracting bank logic into per-bank helper functions; generate_bank_file() is ~270 lines and hard to follow.

bank_files.py — two separate `bank_file_logs.insert_one` calls for the XLSX vs TXT path. The XLSX log entry adds a `format` field but the TXT log does not; consider always writing `format` (defaults to 'txt') for consistent reporting.

PayrollV2Page.jsx:681 — download filename uses `selectedPeriod.description` directly which can include spaces and Spanish chars (e.g. 'Nómina Mar Q1 2026'); some browsers preserve it but it's cleaner to sanitise to underscores like the backend does.

PayrollV2Page.jsx — `achFormat` state is not reset when the user changes bank away from banreservas; if they later come back, the previously chosen format is remembered (acceptable, but worth confirming intended UX).

bank_files.py:295 — when `record_count == 0` for XLSX the bank_file_logs entry has already been inserted before the 400 is raised (insert_one runs at line 288 prior to the check). Move the check above the insert to avoid orphan log rows on failures.

success_rate.frontend: 100% (all UI flows verified: format toggle visible/hidden, default TXT selection, emerald border switch, XLSX URL+filename, TXT URL+filename, dialog reopen)

context_for_next_testing_agent: Banreservas ACH supports TXT (default) and XLSX. Endpoint: GET /api/bank-files/generate/{period_id}/banreservas[?format=xlsx]. XLSX file is sheet 'CONVERTIR NOMINA' with metadata rows 1-5 (labels col A, values col E), 9 column headers at row 8 and data from row 9. TXT format is 8 comma-separated fields per line: CC|CA,DOP|USD,cuenta_empresa,CC|CA,DOP|USD,cuenta_empleado,monto(2dp),concepto. UI: open /payroll, click Periods tab, click a paid period row to expand, click [data-testid='btn-generate-ach'] → dialog with [data-testid='ach-format-group'] (Banreservas only) and cards [data-testid='ach-format-txt'/'ach-format-xlsx']. Submit button is [data-testid='btn-download-ach'].
rca of the issue: No issues found. All acceptance criteria met.
